I don't added a device_class, i choose to make a pull request for an intégration that i use, because it was easier to fix.

@gjohansson-ST   you added this [commit](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/commit/baa511b80873fe3217e0c5542310088241a7bb57), can you provide a bit more explanation the bug you would fix ? it seem's that if one sensor in the group has no device_class, it break the unit of measurement.

if the device_class is None, we don't need to control for converters of Units, because it will always return no Units.

Here is a minimal sample to reproduce the error : 

```
template:
  - sensor:
      - name: "sensor without class"
        unit_of_measurement: "W"
        state: 53

sensor:
  - platform: group
    type: last
    entities:
      - sensor.sensor_without_class
```

Actually the repair is a bit misleading I see now reading it again.
Unless you manually configure a `unit_of_measurement` on your group sensor it will not populate a UoM unless you also have a device class set ( which you can only do in YAML, not from the UI ).

So it's behaving as it's supposed to but again, not being clear on the description of the repair issue.

Anyway we should probably allow to have a calculated UoM if all UoM's on the source entities are the same when not having any device class.

review_comments: Should probably also change a source sensor to another UoM to test that behavior in this case after the asserts below
